scientific_integrity: One affine-orbit classification for the known optimal nine-label cyclic weak B2 checksum; the earlier minimum modulus and witness are acknowledged as published. The argument is exhaustive finite enumeration with two distinct implementations, not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only nine labels over the cyclic group of order 56; no all-modulus or all-code classification.
The full 2004 paper could not be inspected beyond its four original tabular scans; possible priority overlap remains.
title: Affine rigidity of optimal nine-motif cyclic pair-sum labels
